Records.authors: Mikhail V. Kompaniets and Erik Panzer
Records.description: massless propagator computed for the $\varphi^4$ 6-loop calculation available from the ancillary files p_int_g4.mpl (Maple) and p_int_g4.m (Mathematica) of the arXiv submission results are rational linear combinations of multiple zeta values. The pInt[4,11] period for this 4-loop 8-propagator topology is imported here as a Result: value = Cfull^4 * (anc g4 period), the G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization conversion, with the overall sign inherited from the ancillary period (Cfull -> 1 as eps -> 0). Independently validated by pySecDec single-scale Euclidean integration at p^2=-1 (magnitude and transcendental structure at every order; method-independent of the HyperInt reduction that produced the ancillary value).
Records.verifiedVia: pySD-Euclidean s=-1: independent pySecDec single-scale Euclidean integration at p^2=-1 (sector decomposition; method-independent of the HyperInt reduction that produced the ancillary value) reproduces the MAGNITUDE and full transcendental structure of value_ST at every Laurent order eps^-3..eps^1 to Monte-Carlo accuracy. pySD-Euclidean s=-1 (NESO, processes=8, geometric, prefactor exp(4eps*gammaE)) reproduces +value_ST at every order eps^-3..eps^1; sigma=+1; max rel dev 2.0e-10. For this 8-propagator (even nu_tot) integral the pySD-raw output reproduces value_ST DIRECTLY with no sign flip (sigma = +1 = (-1)^nu_tot = (-1)^8); this is a magnitude + transcendental-structure check, NOT an independent sign check. The stored sign is inherited from the ancillary G-scheme period through Cfull^L (Cfull -> 1 as eps -> 0). The Cfull normalization is independently anchored at 2 loops by a first-principles massless-bubble recursion. NOT validated against HyperFLINT/STIntegrate (a HyperInt reimplementation -> circular). Exact anc-level factorization: pInt[4,11] = (1/eps)*pInt[3,8] = pInt[1,1]*pInt[3,8] -- a 1-loop G-scheme bubble (1/eps, the v3-v5 double edge on the external line) times the 3-loop core e12|e3|333|| (pInt[3,8], leading eps^-2). This explains the sub-maximal eps^-3 leading pole (eps^-1 x eps^-2 < eps^-L = eps^-4): the FIRST g4 import shallower than eps^-L. Both reviewers (physics-reviewer SOUND, adversarial-reviewer ROBUST, 2026-06-21) independently reconstructed the pySD Symanzik polynomials from the LIBRARY edge list (U = 20 spanning trees, F = 24 two-forests, both monomial-identical to the pySD log), proving pySD integrated the library graph itself, and excluded the only near-degenerate g4 mate pInt[4,26] at eps^-2 (~1e9 MC sigma).

source.title: Minimally subtracted six loop renormalization of O(n)-symmetric phi^4 theory and critical exponents
source.ancFile: anc/p_int_g4.m -> pInt[4,11]  (g4 = IRR-rearranged auxiliary integrals; valence-4 AND independently pySD-confirmed to equal the unit-power period of this graph; NOT phi^4 self-energies)

import.method: Single-scale phi^4 propagator integral, external scale restored. value = (p^2)^{0 - 4 eps} * Cfull^4 * anc[pInt[4,11]]: the KP G-scheme period series (Cfull = Exp[eps*EulerGamma] Gamma[1+eps] Gamma[1-eps]^2/Gamma[2-2eps], G-scheme -> SubTropica normalization per loop) with the external Euclidean invariant restored, so the stored value is the dimensionful momentum-space integral, not the p^2=1 reduced form. g4: IRR-rearranged auxiliary p-integral (NOT a phi^4 self-energy); 2L-V=0; I ~ (p2)^{-4 eps}; log-divergent, dimensionless. p2 = -MM > 0 : the spacelike (mostly-plus) external invariant, = minus the package mostly-minus Euclidean MM (MM<0; conventions.md L918-924). value = (p2)^{0 - 4 eps} * (dimensionless p2=1 form) is REAL for p2>0 (KP G-scheme). At the pySD anchor MM=-1, i.e. p2=+1, the scale factor is 1, reproducing the anchored period; the i*pi tower appears only on continuation to timelike p2<0 (MM>0). NOT computed by STIntegrate/HyperFLINT (a HyperInt reimplementation; using it to validate the ancillary HyperInt value would be circular).
